openings.claim: Use a cutoff-aware row ledger with explicit replacement edges to separate quantity agreement from transaction-identity agreement.
openings.delta: Change the decision dependency from report recency to supported row lineage. Preserve every original row, duplicate and unmatched row with its batch, original quantity/unit, converted quantity, status interpretation and disposition. Apply only U=5V. Activate supersession only through explicit references and effective-time/cutoff checks. Equal quantities under different row identifiers are candidate correspondence, never proof of identity. Produce twelve batch results with citations: a definite quantity only when supported, otherwise a bounded disagreement without inferred missing quantities. Emit at most three requests naming missing fields or records, grouping affected identifiers where the same missing field applies; leave other uncertainty explicit.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, taking the newer report as authoritative after conversion, the ledger should expose cases where a pre-cutoff amendment and an older replacement quantity would otherwise be counted inconsistently. In the disturbed copy, the missing superseded-row reference and undefined status should create explicit uncertainty instead of unsupported definite quantities. These are predictions, not supplied results.
openings.probe: Implement ledger and recency-rival variants in the supplied spreadsheet/script environment over the sixty rows, eight amendments and twelve identifiers. Run both on the supplied clean and disturbed copies within the shared sixty-minute review budget. Freeze outputs before opening the sealed key; use the extra twenty minutes for comparison of resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts. Also check complete row dispositions and record citations. Parsing/setup failure within the budget means the probe was infeasible, not successful.
assumptions: Explicit references and the supplied dictionary permit some unambiguous dispositions; no unstated cross-report identity mapping is assumed.
Capacity depends on implementing these bounded operations within sixty minutes; this is unverified.

Defeat the claimed advantage if the key shows no reduction in unsupported claims, incorrect lineage handling, or fewer justified resolutions without compensating accuracy. Reject operational suitability if time exceeds sixty minutes, requests exceed three, or any hard constraint fails.

assessment: One testable workflow opening. It preserves stipulated resources and constraints; feasible execution and benefit remain unmeasured. The probe authorizes no deployment or additional records.
